overview: A baker by day and demon fighter by night, Zhong Kui, a reincarnated deity must jog his amnesiac lover's memory of their millennium-long romance.
title: The Devil Punisher

overview: Bong Joo Yi and Ji Yun Seo are best friends who have been single all their lives. Things take a different turn when they share a house with three men, resulting in a chaotic daily life and the anticipation of a possible "first love".
title: Single & Ready to Mingle

overview: Awkward first dates. Fashion faux pas. Badly timed bodily functions. We all have those embarrassing stories – even celebrities and WWE Superstars. On Uncool, Alexa Bliss and her guests dish on their most cringeworthy moments from before the fame and success. So dust off your Furby, open up your Trapper Keeper and get ready for a nostalgic celebration of all things UNCOOL. Follow Alexa Bliss on Instagram @alexa_bliss_wwe_ and join the conversation using #UncoolWithAlexa. Uncool with Alexa Bliss is produced by the Official WWE Podcast Network.
title: Uncool with Alexa Bliss

overview: The arrival of the WWE Network has created a new species of event that alters the company's ecosystem. The role of the live specials exclusive to WWE's streaming service is still evolving, but it's clear that they are both a boon and a hindrance. These WWE Network Specials are multiple things at once.
title: WWE Network Specials

overview: Naked Hustle is an in-depth look into the dark reality of exotic dancing.
title: Naked Hustle

overview: The show featured fitness expert Richard Simmons fulfilling various wishes of guests. Reuniting people with long-lost relatives and paying mortgages were a few of the dreams Simmons made come true.
title: Richard Simmons' Dream Maker

overview: Dildo Kumar has a gift for the lonely people of Kolkata - a Japani doll. No commitment, no emotion: just pure, unlimited fun!
title: Japani Toy

overview: Kainaaz, a Pakistani woman, accidentally crosses the border and is presumed to be a militant. During her imprisonment in India, she gives birth to a daughter, Sehar. When journalist Vedant discovers their story, he sets out to seek justice for the innocent mother and daughter. Enjoy this beautiful journey of love, humanity, and sacrifice, according to The Quint, only on ZEE5.
title: Kaafir

overview: Kark Rogue is a ZEE5 Original Hindi thriller series starring Chitrangada Chakraborty, Indraneil Sengupta, Rajesh Sharma and Jayant Kripalini. A female forensic surgeon, suffering from cancer, identifies an unusual similarity in the number of bodies that she dissects. Suspecting it to be an organised crime, she sets out to uncover the truth.
title: Kark Rogue

overview: Karan Khanna is a recovering alcoholic who, along with his counsellor Tripurasundari Nagrajan, takes a detoxification trip to Mahabaleshwar. The story takes a turn when he attends his estranged daughter's wedding with Tripurasundari Nagrajan and discovers why opposites truly attract. Will their romance blossom? Or will it be just another page in their contrasting lives?
title: Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat

overview: A caring wife, and two loving daughters, Rohit has it all. On the outside, it looks a happy family, but behind the curtains of reality lies the actual truth, Rohit is in love with Ananya. And when the secret finally comes out, it shocks everyone involved. Will Rohit stay with Poonam, with whom he has taken marriage vows? Or will he sacrifice everything for Ananya, his true love?
title: Kehne Ko Humsafar Hain

overview: Khyapa is a story of soul searching of a youth and seeking nirvana. The story is about eponymous hero's journey to find the purpose of his life.
title: Khyapa

overview: Han Ruo Fei obtains a time traveling polaroid that enables him to go back to 10 years ago on short periods of time. He attempts to revive his dead celebrity wife and find the mastermind of the conspiracy plotted against him 10 years ago.
title: Magical Space-Time

overview: Beyond the statesman, who was de Gaulle? What was the driving force and the spring of the man who devoted himself to his country? What role did his discreet wife Yvonne and his daughter Anne play, which gave him the strength to hold out in his great moments of doubt? This film makes us relive the brilliance of the illustrious pages of French history and lifts the veil on the secret of a personality modestly hidden behind the hero's statue.
title: De Gaulle, l'éclat et le secret

overview: What makes someone spend a huge amount of money and time collecting art? And what is the driving force behind the choices they have made?
title: Kunstsamlarane

overview: Lovestruck in the City is a realistic portrayal of young people who pursue romance and happiness while struggling to get by in a busy, competitive urban environment.
title: Lovestruck in the City

overview: The First 48 Presents Critical Minutes looks back at some of the most unforgettable moments in the series' history. Hosted by former First 48 detectives, each episode presents different cases previously featured on the show, all with a common theme.
title: The First 48 Presents Critical Minutes

overview: After the betrayal of her fiancé, Cristina looks for a roommate and finds Alejandro, whom she thinks is gay. When Alejandro decides to confess the truth, it is too late, both are completely in love.
title: De Brutas, Nada

overview: CNN will provide viewers with comprehensive coverage and up-to-the-minute election results from the presidential race and key state races across the country. CNN is deploying resources to keep viewers apprised of updates on vote counts and reports, which may extend beyond election day. The network's team of anchors, correspondents, analysts, reporters and commentators will report from across the country; ramping up to CNN's special Election Night in America coverage.
title: Election Night in America

overview: The NBA Draft is an annual event dating back to 1947 in which the teams from the National Basketball Association can draft players who are eligible and wish to join the league. These are typically college basketball players, but international players are also eligible to be drafted. College players who have finished their four-year college eligibility are automatically eligible for selection, while the underclassmen have to declare their eligibility and give up their remaining college eligibility. International players who are at least 22 years old are automatically eligible for selection, while the players younger than 22 have to declare their eligibility. Players who are not automatically eligible but have declared their eligibility are often called "early-entrants" or "early-entry candidates". The draft usually takes place near the end of June, during the NBA offseason.
title: NBA Draft

overview: Follow the life of five campsites in Denmark, where Danes live in caravans all year round, even though it is not legal.
title: Trailerpark Danmark

overview: Ali B. gets the youth involved with the biggest Dutch songs ever made.
title: Ali B Op Volle Toeren

overview: Discoveries that have revolutionised our understanding of what it means to be human, allowing us to live longer, better, smarter and stronger.
title: Searching for Superhuman

overview: Yesterday Ilya was an eSports legend, and today he is a 38-year-old "old man" that nobody needs. His selfish nature was alienated by fans, sponsors and loved ones. But one day his life changes abruptly: Ilya learns that his daughter Varya followed in her father's footsteps and became an e-sportswoman. Through pain, blood and tears, she succeeds in the brutal world of esports, where there is no place for girls. However, paternal pride did not last long: Ilya understands that Varya is not only talented, but also extremely selfish, which can lead her to failure. To become an example for his daughter, which he never was, Ilya returns to esports. But neither his daughter, nor the esports industry needs him for nothing. And then Ilya decides to do the impossible - to assemble a team and win the world championship.
title: Эра медведей

overview: A futuristic rom-com about women who use a device equipped with artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities to make decisions about who to date.
title: Please Don't Meet Him

overview: Anurag and Sameera go on a date - a night that will change their lives forever. The truth is tested and the lies are revealed when both have completely different versions of the night. Will truth triumph? Or lies prevail?
title: Marzi

overview: Mastram is a story of a writer by the name of Rajaram. The story revolves around the writer Rajaram who is considered as boring and a failure by the publishing house. His story takes a turn when he discovers that inspiration is hidden in everyday life and he starts spinning yarns and turning them into books that become an instant hit. With newfound success and money, how will Rajaram's personal life be affected?
title: Mastram

overview: Siddharth is a well-known news anchor of a popular news channel called "India Now". But along with his being a capable and known anchor, he was also blessed with an unusual superpower. He could touch any dead body and access that dead person's memories, everything about that person's life, good or bad memories, wishes, experiences, desires, secrets, he could see it all like a movie. This gift also allowed him to help the police solve quite a few cases where the secret clues were hidden in the memories of the dead bodies.
title: Memories

overview: Get ready to witness a heart warming musical love story.
title: Monsoon Melodies

overview: A marriage becomes a battlefield of love and doubt. Betrayal - or just suspicion?
title: Love and Affairs

overview: A widow of a decorated army martyr who is running a Dhaba on the outskirts of a national highway in Punjab with the spirit of Seva. She leverages her cooking and metaphorical communication to resolve complex interpersonal issues amicably.
title: Lovely Da Dhaba

overview: Nibedita-RK, and Sukanya-Imtiaj are bored in their married life. Milan Baba's Ashram becomes their ultimate destination!
title: Mismatch

overview: Full coverage of The Trial of Tim Heidecker in which Tim Heidecker stood accused of 20 counts of 2nd degree felony murder against The Electric Sun 20.
title: The Trial

overview: A comedy late-night show hosted by Jan Böhmermann which addresses current (often political) topics.
title: ZDF Magazin Royale

overview: The story of "Olive Hill" passes through a rich seaside town where olives are abundant. Throughout the series, a young girl will challenge a world ruled by bloody men who do not hesitate to do any evil that comes to mind for money, power, and deadly ambition. She will fight a great struggle against the injustices she has with other women in her family.
title: Zeytin Tepesi

overview: Famous faces go toe-to-toe testing their general knowledge in a variety of fun trivia-based games.
title: Richard Osman's House of Games Night

overview: This season on Bad Girls Club, the best of the bad move into a LA mansion, ready to ride the rocky road to change, while making new friends and facing off with old enemies along the way. Life coach Laura returns to help each girl empower themselves, curb their temper and reach their personal goals and aspirations, but will old habits die hard or will these alpha females be ready to change for the better?
title: Bad Girls Club

overview: Wild at Heart catches up with British vet Danny Trevanion and his family as they strive to expand the veterinary practice and co-exist with their neighbours through a drought which grips the region. Danny's wife, Sarah, is busy juggling work and family life, and Lucy-Jo Hudson as daughter Rosie, is keen to prove herself an able vet assistant to her father while romancing bar owner Max.
title: Wild at Heart

overview: Follow the cast and crew of I Told Sunset About You from the very beginning of their preparation to the end of production in Phuket.
title: I Told Sunset About You The Documentary

overview: Packed with big adventure, silly hi-jinks, and heartfelt charm, Pikwik Pack follows Suki the hedgehog and her team, working together to deliver surprise-filled packages to the colourful residents of Pikwik
title: Pikwik Pack

overview: The pages of Woodsmith magazine come to life in this unique concept for public television. Each of the thirteen, half-hour episodes is built around a theme and teaches the skills and safe tool techniques necessary to build a variety of woodworking projects in a home shop. On each program, host Don Peschke, founding editor of Woodsmith, leads a cast of editors and project designers as they explore a wide range of tips, tools, jigs and fixtures, and techniques. Segments on most programs include "The Basics," "Techniques," "Three Things to Consider," "Tool Tune-Up," "Shop Tips," "Oops! When Things Go Wrong," and "Woodworkers' Round-table." Produced by Iowa Public Television in high-definition and shot on a special set built just for this program, most episodes include detailed animations that show exactly how machines work and wood joints are assembled. Whether viewers are just starting out or have been woodworking for years, they'll find something new in every episode to apply to their next project. In addition, a companion website (www.WoodsmithShop.com) offers a handy place to find additional resources and download free technique articles and plans for projects shown in the series.
title: Woodsmith Shop

overview: In a brand, new entertainment show comedian Deirdre O'Kane will be joined by some of the country's most entertaining people to find out what makes them tick and where the funny comes from.
title: Deirdre O'Kane Talks Funny

overview: After a sudden accident in 1995, 10-year-old Imamura Nozomi goes into a coma. Twenty-five years later, in 2020, Nozomi wakes up. Although she is 35 years old, she still acts like she's ten years old. The world has changed around her, but she lives for her future. Yuto was Nozomi's classmate in elementary school, and also her first love. He had once become an elementary school teacher, but quit after a certain incident. In order to hide his lack of confidence, he had been protecting himself by criticizing and looking down on others. When he reunites with Nozomi, he starts to take a good look at himself.
title: A Girl of 35

overview: Independent, immersive, and provocative documentary specials giving voice to radical and unapologetic points of view and tackling broken systems and corrupt power structures head on.
title: Vice Versa

overview: Follow the crew of Cornwall Air Ambulance in this brand new 10-part documentary series, as the team of critical care paramedics and pilots fight to save lives during the unique year that 2020 has been.
title: Cornwall Air 999

overview: Hosted by actor and gun enthusiast Joe Mantegna, Midway USA's Gun Stories takes viewers through a firearm's history, from the heart of the design through its use on the range. Using state-of-the-art, high-speed photography, Gun Stories looks at the operation and performance of each weapon, from classics like the Mauser bolt-action, to cutting-edge firearms like the Adaptive Combat Rifle. Throughout the series, historians, shooters, trainers and industry experts place these weapons in their historical and social context, making Gun Stories a unique and definitive collection on the history of firearms.
title: Gun Stories

overview: Motor Pickers will follow classic car expert Paul Cowland and builder and restorer Helen Stanley as they help desperate car buyers select the perfect used car within their budget. From SUVs to high end sports cars, Helen and Paul will assist buyers as they test a selection of cars and give honest advice as well as their own tips and tricks to help buyers with their selection.
title: Motor Pickers

overview: Moscow, 1978, on the eve of the Olympic Games. In the Soviet Union, several cases of fraud were registered, the victims of which were women "with a position in society." The victims describe the signs of the criminal in the same way: a charming, intelligent middle-aged man, easily rubbed into confidence.
title: Казанова

overview: In 2020, there is one theme that has overshadowed everything else - the pandemic. When Norway shut down, we turned on the cameras. Through unique access to decision makers, companies and various people, we have documented how we have all had our lives affected by a virus. We are close to the government and health officials who talk about some of their most difficult decisions. We see how nurses, teachers and entrepreneurs deal with a brutal reality with great upheavals and fears, and we follow Hurtigruten who is trying to maneuver through its biggest crisis ever. The result is a surprising, close and personal story about how we as humans and nation have lived under the threat of the coronavirus.
title: Norge i krise

overview: Police captain Oleh Dolin opens his eyes in a hospital bed and learns that he has been in a coma for about 20 years. During this time, the world has changed, the militia has turned into the police, rackets and "brothers" have become a thing of the past, and in the current reality, everyone is "sitting" in gadgets, shooting blogs, and, quite surprisingly, eating sushi with drumsticks. For the "newcomer" from the bad 90s, who has kept professional skills, the heart and soul of a young guy, there will be a job in the new police force. After all, as before, bad guys do bad things... Based on the format of the German series Der Lezte Bulle.
title: Коп з минулого

overview: Pauley Shore is back in TBS's Minding the Store, where he manages the family business, world famous comedy club, The Comedy Store. Mom Mitzi Shore reluctantly hands over control to son Pauley with the hope that he can breathe new life into the club. Pauley has great plans for the club including renovations, A-list talent, and new promotions, but can he succeed with his mom watching his every move?
title: Minding the Store

overview: "Remington Country" pairs a trio of true hunting experts with America's greatest maker of firearms and ammunition to create the ultimate destination for outdoor viewers. Remington Country features three hunting professionals who aren't just weekend warriors, they do this for a living 365 days a year. By spending decades in the field leading all levels of clients, they have seen just about every mistake a hunter can make and share this knowledge with the viewer. In every episode we will uncover the ‘behind the scenes' moments for the three hosts to see what it really takes to get a client – or themselves – within range of a great trophy.
title: Remington Country

overview: Changing the norms of love, romance and marriage in today's world, the latest romantic Punjabi show Mr and Mrs Kohli, an MX Exclusive and Mirchi Play Original, brings about a change in the set gender roles in a marriage. Directed by Dheeraj Padiyar, the star cast of the latest Punjabi web series includes Sara Gurpal and Sahil Vedoliya in the roles of Sara & Sapan. The married couple lives a normal life like anybody else, one person earns for the family and the other runs the household, but the gender roles have been reversed. Sara - Mrs Kohli goes to work while Sapan - Mr Kohli is the house maker, who remains at home and performs the household chores. Exploring the new ways of love and breaking the gender norms, this show will open new horizons for a modern way of living.
title: Mrs. and Mr. Kohli

overview: Robert Rinder helps Jewish families discover the full truth about what happened to their relatives during the Holocaust.
title: My Family, The Holocaust and Me

overview: Marking 25 years since Britain tuned in to watch Diana, Princess of Wales pour her heart out on national television, these two programmes hear from those who witnessed her fairytale romance with Prince Charles descend into rancour and ultimately divorce. Through previously unseen documents and testimony from eyewitnesses who have never spoken before, the programmes reveal how and why the extraordinary interview came about. The Princess revealed a royal marriage in crisis, infidelities on both sides, and a degree of personal misery that had made her seriously ill. It was watershed television, affecting public perceptions of the monarchy and prompting a constitutional crisis, but what had led to this extraordinary moment?
title: The Diana Interview: Revenge of a Princess

overview: She is a two-time Emmy Award winner for her fearless documentaries. Now Deeyah Khan takes a closer look at what the Trump presidency has meant for abortion resistance and Muslimness.
title: Deeyah Khan i Trumps USA

overview: When Governor Peter Akala dies from an automobile accident, not only is the state thrown into mourning, but the party hierarchy is also thrown into disarray as well, as there is an informal succession plan which has been pre-arranged, but which is now threatened by the constitution, which is set to produce a new governor who is not only a political ‘outsider', but a woman as well!
title: The Governor

overview: They said, there's nothing wrong about love. But what if it is against our culture? Strange Heart is a story about family, love, and destiny. This will address some of the cultural issues about same-sex relationship. It shows the supremacy of love that really answers all the uncertainties and addresses the challenges through acceptance. Love is inevitable and irreversible. Kristof and Joshua will face this reality as if nobody is in-charge, no matter what it takes.
title: Strange Heart

overview: Takaki runs a small cardboard processing company. One day, he killed himself. He did this because of Yoshiyuki. Yoshiyuki is the CEO of a company that works with Takaki's company. Due to Yoshiyuki, Takaki's company went bankrupt because of heavy debts. This caused Takaki to jump off of a rooftop building. Despite the appeals from Takaki's family, Yoshiyuki was unpunished by the law. Takaki 's son Kazuma and Takaki 's nephew Mitsuru decide to take revenge on Yoshiyuki.
title: Satsui no Dotei

overview: Hosted by Andrew O'Keefe, the greatest quiz brains in Australia will try to beat all four of The Chasers. The ultimate glory - big cash prizes in the Grand Finale.
title: Beat the Chasers

overview: Journey back in time to Berlin's most fateful year - 1945 - through the eyes and voices of those who experienced it - ordinary German people and the Allies who entered the city.
title: Berlin 1945

overview: David Koster is an obsessive New York City assistant district attorney who gets into trouble because of his passion for justice. His boss, Anthony Celese, tries to keep him under control while New York police detective Frank Malloy helps him solve cases. Koster's wife Jessica is a viola player in a string quartet and her own life's priorities come into conflict with David's.
title: For the People

overview: After their trip to Middlesbrough turned a little more explosive than they thought, Gemma and Terry finally decide to pack up the smouldering remains of their coach tour business and set out on a new adventure as fully-fledged private detectives.
title: Murder, They Hope

overview: Can a young woman form a proper Southern family and an offbeat, urban Jewish man succeed in marriage? Love conquers all in this warmhearted romantic comedy.
title: You're the One

overview: Natalie 'Nate' Cross works for the government - any government that pays, that is. Technically, she's a subcontractor - like Haliburton, only with guns. She gets hired to hunt down scum and dispose of them - and she always gets her man. Always.
title: Pink

overview: On Pointe captures a season in the School of American Ballet (SAB) in New York City. Featuring unprecedented access to the famous ballet institution, the series follows the lives of the students ages 8 to 18 pursuing their dreams to become ballet dancers. While older students from all over the country rigorously train for professional careers, younger students from New York City are put through their paces as they rehearse and perform in New York City Ballet's holiday classic "George Balanchine's The Nutcracker" onstage at Lincoln Center.
title: On Pointe

overview: ATEEZ Fever Road takes inspiration from ATEEZ's story universe and challenges the members to embark on an adventure, full of various missions.
title: ATEEZ Fever Road

overview: Murder at My Door with Kym Marsh explores four cases of innocent people murdered by someone they thought they could trust. The stories show that someone's safe place, their sanctuary, is also somewhere they can be at their most vulnerable. In the show, Kym Marsh narrates with her distinct empathetic style the tragic deaths of Ellie Gould, Gagandip Singh, Jenny Methven, and Susan Annis, victims who unknowingly opened their door to evil, experiencing the ultimate betrayal in the most intimate of settings.
title: Murder at My Door with Kym Marsh

overview: Five years ago, music teacher Zeynep moved with her two young children and her doctor husband Ahmet to their beautiful home in their newly appointed town, and was sure that their future would be as perfect as that summer morning. She wished a wish on her birthday. But in the subsequent five years that followed, she lost everything. Commissioner Sinan never left Zeynep's side, and as a result of his great love for her, he lost his job. Zeynep tried one last way to get back what she lost, and hand-in-hand with Sinan, they stubbornly took back everything she lost, one after one.
title: Kefaret

overview: The drama series follows the story of a mother and her young daughter, Serra, as they try to get used to their new life in an ordinary neighborhood after falling from grace.
title: Sol Yanım

overview: Hey Joe follows musical expert Joe Pérez-Orive as he travels to four countries to learn about their music and better understand their customs and society. In each of the episodes, Joe will be accompanied by well-known characters such as the comedian Pepe Colubi or the musician Coque Malla.
title: Hey Joe

overview: Stylish with Jenna Lyons follows Jenna as she tackles design projects that will help define her future business. Join her in this ambitious new venture, delivering a masterclass in taste, design, and fashion in every episode.
title: Stylish with Jenna Lyons

overview: Set around the not so glamorous world of greyhound racing in London's East End, this comic drama features an excellent cast of British actors. When Jim is released from prison he sees the greyhounds as his chance to get rich quick. Standing in his way is Larry, a millionaire who owns all the best dogs. Their rivalry is heightened when luckless Jim falls in love with Larry's wife Lauren, making life even harder for Jim's son Little Jim who works for Larry and therefore finds himself very much stuck in the middle!
title: Gone to the Dogs

overview: A Communist spy serving as an officer of the Japanese puppet regime joins hands with Russian and Korean spies to execute an assassination plot.
title: Sheng Suan

overview: Addicted Australia is a bold, brave and innovative Australian television first that shines a light on a growing crisis affecting millions of Australians – addicts as well as their families and loved ones - in a deeply powerful and personal way. Extraordinary, never-before seen access, is gained to the lives of a group of Australians and their families as they confront their addiction head on. Signed up to a unique holistic six-month treatment program, this series follows the heart-wrenching journey of 10 participants and their families from despair to hope and possible recovery.
title: Addicted Australia

overview: I Cavalieri di Castelcorvo focuses on a brother and sister called Riccardo and Giulia, aged 11 and 13. They have to move to Castelcorvo to stay with their Aunt Margherita to attend school. They meet two other children, Matteo and Betta, who go on to become The Knights of Castelcorvo and face a number of challenges including magic puzzles, keys and board games, witches and places outside of time and space.
title: I Cavalieri di Castelcorvo
